paragraphs.text: Sylvene was a Ravnican planeswalker that was introduced in the lore accompanying Dungeons & Dragons: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms . She was the grandmother of Tyreus .
Sylvene was a wise and thoughtful human mage from Ravnica who combined adventurous explorations with an almost anthropological study of the Forgotten Realms .

Sylvene visited the Realms decades ago and was one of the wizards who taught and practiced magic in the Wizard’s Barrow on the High Moor . She fell in love with a local man and built a refuge for them in a small demiplane of her creation . Unfortunately, her husband lost his life in a misadventure in Moor. Sylvene was pregnant when he died, and she gave birth to their son, Tyberio, in Waterdeep . She eventually returned to Ravnica to raise him, and she passed away when Tyberio was twelve.

Tyberio rebelled by refusing to study magic. He sought a quiet life as a craftsman and merchant but carried a certain bitterness and resentment toward the world of Ravnica. He always wanted to visit the land where his parents had met but never managed to. Tyberio started a family with his wife, Ayraea, and had one son. In bitterness, Tyberio forbade his son Tyreus from studying magic — but it didn’t work. Tyberio’s teenage son secretly began learning the ways of mages the same summer that, coincidentally, Tyberio and Ayraea passed away from a minor plague.
Furious over his parents’ fears of magic, their death, and his powerlessness, Tyreus devoted his life to magic thereafter.

Although it was explicitly stated that the Dungeons & Dragons setting of the Forgotten Realms is not considered to be canonically part of Magic' s Multiverse , the Magic Story released with the set mixed the flavor anyway.
